subject: Jira access denied
body: My Jira account is locked. I cannot access my project. This affects only me, not production; please treat this as medium priority.

subject: Slack outage
body: Slack is unavailable to the whole company during an active emergency. This is a critical incident blocking all incident coordination.

subject: Email delivery is slow
body: Email takes 20 minutes to arrive for our team. Messages eventually arrive; no outage or data loss. Medium priority performance issue.

subject: Identity login blocked
body: The identity provider rejects my login with access denied. Only my account is affected. Please investigate at medium priority.

subject: Platform staging deployment fails
body: Our platform staging deployment fails during container startup. Production is unaffected, but this blocks today's release. High priority deployment issue.

subject: Prometheus dashboard question
body: Where can I find the Prometheus dashboard documentation? Nothing is broken. This is a low priority general question.

subject: Office stationery request
body: Can someone arrange more notebooks for the office? This is unrelated to any supported software service. Low priority general request.

subject: Jira searches time out
body: Jira search queries time out for everyone and block today's work. This is a high priority performance problem, not an access or deployment issue.

subject: Slack channel naming
body: What is the naming convention for new Slack channels? No errors or access issues. Low priority general question.

subject: Company email outage
body: All company email delivery has stopped. No employee can send or receive messages. This is a critical production incident.

subject: Identity provider production outage
body: The identity provider is down globally, preventing every user from authenticating to production. Critical incident, not an individual access request.

subject: Platform API latency
body: The platform API is slower than normal but still responds successfully. No deployment occurred and no outage is present. Medium priority performance issue.
